description.value: Me-n-Ed's is a proudly Canadian-owned pizza parlour chain operating in the Lower Mainland since 1969, known for specialty and classic pizzas made with fresh ingredients. This Kingsway location is one of five family-operated restaurants and serves local BC craft beers on tap alongside its full pizza menu. A touring cyclist looking for a filling sit-down meal or a quick takeout order on a busy arterial route will find a reliable, long-established stop here.
